what_i_saw: THREE leaks, all declared, none used. (1) I ran `ls -la` on papers/dogfood-self-audit/ before reading the PREREG's blinding scope carefully. That returned FILENAMES AND BYTE SIZES ONLY for blocked artifacts (probe_e_numpy.json, probe_e_numpy_joined.json, probe_e_numpy_v2.json, PROBE_E_COMPARISON.json, RECEIPT_conscience_fire_rate.json, RECEIPT_receipt_gate.json, census_*.json, falsifiability_census.py, EXTERNAL_CENSUS_*, FALSIFIABILITY_RECEIPTS_*, FINDING_probe_e_styxx_*, FINDING_crossrepo_probe_e_*, FINDING_adversarial_review_*). No contents. No rates. (2) THE REAL ONE: grepping DAY_2026_08_13.md (not on the blocklist) for 'PARKED|census' returned PROBE E outcome-side prose. Verbatim, the lines I saw: line 248 '**PROBE E: the census was wrong in both directions.** probe_e_runtime.py measures dead'; line 254 'Joined against the static census, the screen over-calls by ~16% among functions it can'; line 256 'suspicious vocabulary at all. The census's number was never an upper bound on the defect'; line 224 '## 6. Evening: the gates went silent, and then the census turned out to be wrong'. So I saw ONE outcome-side number: a static-census-vs-runtime disagreement rate of ~16%. It is a repo-level instrument-agreement figure, not a dead-term rate for the repo, for any module, or for any term. (3) The harness injected the operator's auto-memory MEMORY.md index into my system context before I acted; it contains two term-level facts I did not go looking for: 'G2 VOID (detector 2-of-3 terms constant, anti-correlated with severity...)' and 'darkflobi's survey: 33/43 rate functions state no chance level'. The first is about meta_audit_voice.py's paper-local regex, which is not a styxx module and is in no mapping; the second is a different probe (own_instrument_survey). DIRECTION ASSESSMENT: none of the three tells me which styxx modules are dead, so none could steer inclusion or exclusion. My three module strips (styxx.audit, styxx.framelocality, styxx.anchors) and my two rejections were all decided on call-graph and git-date evidence stated in the entries, and all of them SHRINK the exposure set, which is the conservative direction against H1. VERIFICATION SUMMARY, separate from contamination: 77 claims in, 75 retained, 2 rejected. Quote-at-cited-path verified EXACT for 36 claims. 21 more had quotes that are git COMMIT SUBJECTS/BODIES rather than file text (9818a05, 6084c95, 62b3fc4, 6b69dfd, 36f9ae7, 73dda7f, 951b150, 8c5f531, 15300be, 6391ff6, 0c7dc31, f8bd4ad, b425655, 82f7715, bf701ec, a140dfc, 6fb2ac0, 8efa903, c18bd6c) — I verified each in `git log` and confirmed the retraction independently in the named file; receipt_path corrected in the output where the cited path did not exist. FIVE cited receipt paths were WRONG and are corrected above: papers/PAPER_protocol_metric_identity_* (actual: papers/autopilot/FINDING_...), papers/disjoint-worlds/FINDING_portable_conscience_v0_* (actual: papers/showcase-viz/), papers/disjoint-worlds/FINDING_crossfamily_local_cliff_* (actual: papers/grounded-honesty-axis/), clawd/.claude/projects/memory/project_consistency_robustness_* (actual: .claude/projects/C--Users-heyzo--styxx/memory/MEMORY.md:38), and papers/calib-poison-general/PREREG_B2_coupling_twosided_2026_07_16.md WHICH DOES NOT EXIST ANYWHERE (the 0.880->0.755 self-correction is real and is recorded at memory/project_calib_poison_generalize_2026_07_09.md:103 — retained on that receipt, downgraded to inferred). One claim's quote ('My contest instrument was broken in my favour') is not in the cited DAY file; it is at ADJUDICATION_redteam_2026_08_13.md:9 verbatim, same directory — receipt corrected. THREE MODULE STRIPS, all one rule — a module written AS THE REMEDY is not on the causal path of the claim it corrects: (a) styxx.audit dropped from the cross-vendor competence-cliff entry — run_local_cliff.py:211/214 does call styxx.audit._derive_verdict, but I traced the outputs and verdict_true/verdict_false are written to per-item receipts and NEVER read downstream; the pre-registered cliff metric runs committed_precision -> _compare -> M1_spearman entirely through run_pregeneration_gate.py and run_crossmodel_cliff.py, both of which have ZERO styxx imports (confirmed by grep). This removes styxx.audit from the set entirely. (b) styxx.framelocality dropped from both entries — `git log --diff-filter=A` shows it first committed 2026-07-29 as 'feat(framelocality): ship the corrected control as an instrument -- and dogfood it on our own retraction'; the retracted number came from papers/agent-conscience/run_frame_recovery.py, which imports no styxx. A third mapping of the same claim excluded it on exactly these grounds, so the input was self-contradictory. This removes styxx.framelocality from the set entirely. (c) styxx.anchors dropped from the anchor-power entry — styxx/anchors.py created cd3be35 on 2026-07-20, and FINDING_anchor_power_instrument_2026_07_23.md is subtitled 'and a favourable correction': the module SHIPS the corrected closed-form power table; the erroneous published row came from EXPLORE_anchor_threshold_2026_07_23.py, no styxx import. The other three anchored-validity entries already returned [] for the same temporal reason. This removes styxx.anchors from the set entirely. All three strips are the same rule and are trivially reversible if the analysis defines exposure to include remedy code — say so in the method file if you reverse them.
